items.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
G: Excuse me. May I bring my dog to the store?
M: ______________ You must not bring pets inside.
G: OK. I understand.

items.stem: A와 B의 대화가 어색한 것은?
choices:
A: Can you please carry this box to my car?
B: I'm really sorry, but I'm late for my class.

A: Look. Somebody forgot to turn off the water.
B: Again? People are so forgetful.

A: I'd like a banana smoothie, please.
B: For here or to go?

A: May I take a picture of it?
B: Yes, you may, but you must not use the flash.

A: Can you please put it in a plastic cup, not in a glass?
B: Sure. We don't use plastic cups inside the café.
items.explain: Sure.(승낙) 뒤에 플라스틱 컵을 쓰지 않는다는 말이 이어져 모순.

items.stem: 주어진 우리말을 영작한 문장으로 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: Would you like to have a piece of cake for dessert?
Would you like have a piece of cake for dessert?
Would you like to have a piece cake for dessert?
Would you like to having a piece of cake for dessert?
Would you like to have piece of a cake for dessert?
items.explain: would like to + 동사원형, a piece of cake.

items.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어는?
items.box:
I'm so hungry. Let's eat ________.
The next day, I made a nice lunch ________ of the leftovers.
items.explain: eat out 외식하다 / make A out of B: B로 A를 만들다.

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
items.box:
A: Who is the youngest of the four?
B: ______________________________
choices: Wonder Woman is youngest of the four.
Wonder Woman is the youngest in the four.
Wonder Woman is the youngest of the four.
Wonder Woman is the most young of the four.
Wonder Woman is the youngest than the four.

items.stem: 다음 단어에 대한 영어 뜻풀이로 적절하지 않은 것은?
choices: criminal: someone who commits a crime
trash: things that you don't want and throw away
machine: a piece of equipment with moving parts that uses electricity to do work
owner: someone who visits a place for a short time

items.stem: 다음은 단어와 영어 뜻풀이를 작성한 것이다. 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
items.box:
plog: to pick up ________ while jogging
produce: to make or ________ something
eat out: to eat in a ________
in return: as a response, exchange, or ________ for something

items.stem: 다음 문장의 의미상 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 단어는?
items.box:
I ________ my leg so I used a wheelchair.
The movie starts with a scary ________.
I ________ my first day of school.
You look like an old lady with the gray ________.
items.source: 학습지 L5 Vocabulary Advanced B · Workbook B-2

items.stem: 글의 흐름상 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
items.box: I like my neighborhood. Is there a beautiful park near your house? There is one near mine. In the park, there ⓐ[is/are] a small lake. There ⓑ[is/are] flowers and tall trees around the lake. Some families ⓒ[is/are] having a picnic in the park. The people in the park look happy.
items.explain: a small lake → is, flowers and trees → are, Some families → are.

items.stem: 우리말 해석에 맞는 문장을 영작할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
choices:
There ________ twenty questions on the exam.
시험에 스무 문제가 있다.

There ________ apples at the market.
시장에 사과들이 있다.

There ________ many students at the gym.
체육관에 많은 학생들이 있다.

There ________ some mistakes in the report.
보고서에 몇 가지 실수가 있다.

There ________ much cheese on the pizza.
피자에 치즈가 많이 있다.
items.explain: cheese는 셀 수 없는 명사 → is. 나머지는 are.

items.stem: 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 알맞지 않은 것은?
choices: We'll <u>move on to</u> Monet's paintings next. (~로 넘어가다)

items.box:
G: I'd like a banana smoothie, please.
M: For here or to go?
G: For here, please. And (A) ______________________
M: I'm sorry, but we don't use single-use plastic cups inside the café.
G: Oh, I see.

items.stem: 위 대화의 흐름상 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: can you please put it in a plastic cup, not in a glass?
can I have a glass of water?
may I take it to go?
can you please close the door?
do you have a paper bag?
items.explain: 플라스틱 컵을 쓰지 않는다는 답이 이어진다.
items.source: L6 Review 3 · Watch and Talk A-2

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: The girl will drink the smoothie in the café.
The girl asked for a plastic cup.
The café doesn't use single-use plastic cups inside.
The girl will get her smoothie in a glass.
The man will put the smoothie in a plastic cup.
items.explain: 카페 안에서는 일회용 플라스틱 컵을 쓰지 않는다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
choices: Who is the boy next <u>to</u> Mina?
I plan <u>to</u> visit the village again next week.

lines: Every day, we ⓐ<u>produce</u> (가)<u>lots of waste</u>, and the Earth is getting (나)<u>sicker and sicker</u>. Do you want to save the Earth? (A) Then, join the zero-waste challenge, and share your stories.

Olivia: My birthday was last Saturday, and my family and I ate out. There were lots of ⓑ<u>leftovers</u>, but we brought them home. (B) The next day, I (다)<u>made a nice lunch out of them</u>. FYI, you can find great cooking ideas for leftovers on the Internet.

Emma: I often use food ⓒ<u>delivery</u> services, but today I didn't. (C) I heard that (라)<u>plastic never go away</u> ⓓ<u>completely</u>. (D) I didn't use (마)<u>some</u> single-use plastic today. I felt good!

Minsu: Yesterday, I took some plastic and glass bottles to a recycling machine near my house. I put them into the machine (바)<u>one by one</u>, and I got some points ⓔ<u>in fact</u>. (E) What can I do with those points? Well, I can use them like money. Don't you think that's cool?

items.stem: 윗글의 (A)~(E) 중 문맥상 주어진 문장이 들어갈 곳으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: Instead, I walked to my favorite restaurant with a reusable container and picked up the food.
items.explain: 배달을 이용하지 않았다는 말 뒤, Instead로 이어진다 (C).

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
윗글을 읽고 대답을 찾을 수 없는 질문은?
choices: What did Olivia do on her birthday?
Where can you find cooking ideas for leftovers?
What did Emma use instead of single-use plastic?
How did Minsu get some points?
How much money did Minsu get?
items.explain: 포인트를 돈처럼 쓸 수 있다고만 했다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (가)~(바) 중 문맥상, 어법상 옳은 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
items.explain: (라) never go → never goes (plastic 단수), (마) some → any (부정문).

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것은?
다음 중 밑줄 친 that을 생략할 수 없는 것은?
choices: Do you know <u>that</u> girl over there?
I heard <u>that</u> you are interested in science.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 말에 담긴 의도로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
B: May I go to the video room, Mom?
W: Of course, but don't run.
B: Why not?
W: Look at that sign. <u>You must not run inside the museum.</u>

box.title: Who Stole the Gold Rings?
lines: Someone stole the gold rings from Mr. Brown's jewelry shop last night. There are four suspects – John, Tim, Steve, and Mike. The ⓐ<u>criminal</u> is Mike. This is for the following reasons. First, (A)<u>John은 키가 180cm보다 더 작아서</u>, he is not the criminal. Second, Tim doesn't have blue eyes, so he is not the criminal, either. Lastly, Steve has red hair, so he isn't the criminal.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)를 어법상 옳은 영어로 작성한 것은?
choices: John is short than 180 cm, so
John is shorter than 180 cm, so
John is more short than 180 cm, so
John is the shortest than 180 cm, so
John is shortest of 180 cm, so

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 영어 뜻풀이로 알맞은 것은?
choices: a person who saw something happen, for example, a crime
someone who is thought to be guilty of a crime
a notice giving information, directions, a warning, etc.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: The rings were stolen this morning.
Steve isn't the criminal because he has red hair.
items.explain: last night / four suspects / Tim doesn't have blue eyes / Mike가 범인.

items.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
I am not good at sewing.
She loves to play the piano.
To learn about history is fun.
I don't think that she will talk with Minsu.
I use often food delivery services.
They didn't enjoy to solve puzzles.
There is many people in the park.
items.explain: 틀린 것: I often use / enjoy solving / There are many people.

items.stem: 글을 읽고 질문에 대한 답을 글에서 찾아 Because로 시작하는 8단어의 영어 문장으로 작성하시오.

lines: Camila Santos, the owner of Camila's Bakery

Last Friday, a young man came in. I spoke to him in Spanish, but he didn't understand me. He spoke only English. We had a lot of different cakes, but he just wanted the smallest one. We sold only one cake that day, so I remember him clearly. Oh, he had blue eyes.
질문: Camila, why do you remember the young man clearly?

items.answer: Because we sold only one cake that day.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 친 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 조건에 맞는 영어 문장을 작성하시오.
items.box:
G: I'm sorry, but I don't want to go out now. <u>식당에 가서 음식을 포장해 올 수 있니?</u>
B: Sure. No problem.
condition: can, please, pick up을 반드시 사용할 것
items.answer: Can you please go to a restaurant and pick up some food?

items.stem: 주어진 모든 단어를 한 번씩만 사용하여 알맞은 순서로 배열하고 우리말 뜻과 일치하는 문장을 작성하시오.
items.box:
나는 그 남자가 파란 눈을 가지고 있었다고 생각한다.
( think / blue eyes / I / had / the man / that )
items.answer: I think that the man had blue eyes.
